name: Catalyst Analytics
author: Angelo Abi Hanna

sections.description:
Catalyst Analytics lets you easily create A/B tests using WordPress blocks and track which variant performs better. Create split tests for any content using intuitive Gutenberg blocks and get detailed analytics on performance.

Features:
* Block-based A/B testing interface
* Real-time conversion tracking
* Detailed analytics dashboard
* Split traffic control
* Click and form submission tracking
* Visual performance charts
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/catalyst-analytics/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the “Catalyst Analytics” menu in your dashboard to view results.
  4. Start creating A/B tests using the Catalyst Analytics blocks in the Gutenberg editor.
sections.faq:
How are conversions tracked?

Views and interactions (clicks on links, buttons, and form submissions) are recorded using AJAX and stored in WordPress options.

Can I control the traffic split between variants?

Yes, you can set custom split percentages for each test variant in the block settings.

Where can I view my test results?

Results are available in the Catalyst Analytics dashboard in your WordPress admin area.
